_doc: Evaluation set for semantic act search (docs/roadmap.md, plan step 0). Each query is a plain-language description; `expected` lists acceptable acts (any one in the top k counts as a hit). Expected ELI ids verified against api.sejm.gov.pl on 2026-11-01 (all IN_FORCE). `kind`: `lexical` = words of the description appear in the act title, `mismatch` = they do not. `source`: who wrote the query; queries written by the developer knowing the titles are biased, so queries from real users are added with source `user`. Queries with `source: web` were collected from public Q&A pages (url, date, asker) by search-result order, not chosen by title match; `expected` = acts cited in the published answer that are in force (checked in ELI on 2026-11-01), `cited_not_in_force` = cited acts repealed since. `headline: true` = the portal's question-style headline, not the asker's own words. Queries with `kind: regulation` (added 2026-11-01) come from public Q&A pages whose answers cite a regulation in force (checked in ELI on 2026-11-01); `expected` lists only the cited regulations (a statute cited alongside, in `also_cited`, does not count), because they test whether the regulation itself is found. Nearly all of them are portal headlines from kadry.infor.pl, not askers' own words.
